name: Project Context page, not-cloned empty state, and agent/skill Context tabs
description: From the seeded repo, open the sidebar 'Project Context' item (AC-1), confirm the not-cloned empty state (AC-10; the seeded repo has no local clone), then open the seeded Security Reviewer agent and injection-guard skill and switch to their Context tab (AC-14, AC-21). Read-only seeded data. Doc list, preview and attach (AC-5, AC-64) need a cloned repo the seed does not provide, so they are RTL-only. Waits avoid CSS-uppercased text.

steps.label: click the sidebar Project Context item
navigate to the project context route
repo name is visible in the breadcrumb
not-cloned empty state renders (seeded repo has no clone)
agents fetch settles before the card click
switch to the agent Context tab
context tab is active in the URL

cmd: Order matters — earlier docs appear earlier
steps.label: agent Context tab hint renders
filter the rail so the card is at the top (it is below the fold in the nested scroll rail and the click would miss)
filtered list settles before the card click
switch to the skill Context tab
context tab is active in the URL
